data.title: Adam opens confidential Model II cooperation talks

actions.description: After Aurelia launch and growing dealer sales, Adam demonstrates Abacus and proposes an official Model II CP/M configuration plus FlexiBUS in return for an AION-funded Abacus adaptation. Talks occur during the scenario early-design window; no historical design-freeze date is asserted. Confidential talks have no immediate mass-market demand effect.
